text:
rachel: heads-up — onboarding sample-app shows intermittent truncated JSON in the browser when streaming long completions. go and python SDKs are fine. filing here before a wider postmortem.
omar: can you paste repro steps?
rachel: run `examples/onboard-streaming` with `LONG_PROMPT=true` and open http://localhost:3000. ~1/8 runs show UI error `Unexpected end of JSON input`. logs attached.
rachel: ```
[2065-04-07T11:02:02.123Z] proxy: recv client disconnect signal id=cli-77
[2065-04-07T11:02:02.124Z] runtime: emit seq=8 data="{\"partial\": \"...\""
[2065-04-07T11:02:02.125Z] runtime: keepalive (empty event)
[2065-04-07T11:02:02.126Z] runtime: emit seq=9 data=", \"more\": 123}"
[2065-04-07T11:02:02.127Z] client/browser: EventSource.onerror -> close
[2065-04-07T11:02:02.128Z] parser WARN: truncated JSON after seq=8
```
yuki: sounds like the client treats an empty event or onerror as final. go/python SDKs buffer across those. browser sample app currently does: `if (e.data.trim() === '') { flushHeartbeat(); } else { tryJSON(e.data) }` — so split JSON across empty event can break it.
omar: is the proxy doing CRLF normalization? ops team saw similar with load-balancer inserting extra CRLFs on abort.
ops-bot: INFRA-2102 created to track proxy CRLF normalization on client-abort path.
yuki: possible mitigations: 1) sample-app: accumulate chunk data into a buffer and only parse when we detect valid JSON (try/catch). 2) debounce heartbeat handling so single empty events never trigger finalization. 3) runtime: emit explicit `event: keepalive` and `event: final` with `data: {"seq": N, "type": "final"}` so clients have an unambiguous signal.
rachel: for onboarding we should prefer client-side forgivingness. new sample helper `sseReassembler()` can stitch partial messages and expose `onmessageObject(obj)`.
omar: also add a short note in SDK docs: "Browsers treat SSE heartbeat + onerror differently; prefer explicit event names or use our helper".
yuki: will send PRs: web-sample + README tweak + unit that simulates keepalive + token interleave + auth refresh reconnect.
ci-bot: CI: ran 20 streaming-e2e runs on branch with reassembler: 20/20 pass, baseline was 17/20.
rachel: nice. follow-up: infra to change proxy behavior if INFRA-2102 shows consistent CRLF rewrite. also runtime RFC to consider explicit event names.
yuki: one more SDK parity note: node SDK uses `eventsource` polyfill which emits `message` for empty data differently than browser EventSource — call out in docs.
omar: okay to merge sample-app patch once tests green. leaving TODO: telemetry to log keepalive vs token counts per client so we can correlate flakes.
rachel: thanks all — will add a quick blurb in onboarding guide so new users don't get spooked by partial renders. :sparkles:
